description: This file defines the AttendanceReportData class, which implements report data processing for attendance reports in the OrangeHRM system. It retrieves attendance records, formats the output, and provides metadata such as total attendance duration.

classes.name: AttendanceReportData
classes.description: Implements report data processing and formatting for attendance reports within OrangeHRM, utilizing injected traits for attendance, number formatting, and internationalization functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the AttendanceReportData instance with search filter parameters.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Retrieves attendance records, formats employee names and total hours, and returns the processed data array.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Generates metadata about the attendance report, including total hours and count.
